verdict.rationale: Google's own Data API docs point to official client libraries in Java, Python, Node.js, PHP, C#, Go and Ruby, with a client library quickstart, for programmatic access to GA4 report data. The Data API and Admin API are documented REST surfaces those libraries build on. Missing for 10: evidence that official SDKs also cover the Admin API and Measurement Protocol, deeper SDK documentation beyond a single quickstart mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
